strongest_admission_steelman: The draft repeatedly preserves STOP/PRESERVE, forbids repository and physical RABBIT output, makes gates conjunctive, preserves raw failures, names a mechanism-deletion negative control, and limits any positive conclusion to an external-candidate intake review. With prior owner authority for nonphysical execution and a much smaller single-authority bundle, those controls could form a useful cheap-kill screen.
decisive_falsifier: Rejection is falsified by a sealed revision that cites explicit owner authority for external nonphysical execution, uses one authoritative contract and at most one <=800-LOC microprototype, freezes every novelty/domain/norm/arithmetic definition before output, proves semantic mechanism reachability under controlled mutants rather than seal/import failure, and returns an empty repository PR queue until intake PASS plus a separate owner design decision.
stance_change_condition: Change to intake-ready only when all six minimal corrections below are present in the exact prompt bytes and an independent reread finds no alternate authority or truth surface.

minimal_binding_corrections.correction: Delete the request's self-authorization of executable experiments unless an exact prior owner decision authorizing external nonphysical execution is cited. Without it, permit report-only design analysis and no lab run.

Reduce the pool to two or three complete alternatives or a reasoned no-go, implement at most one prototype, and cap the bundle at one machine contract, one runner, one mechanism module, one test/proof module, raw outputs, <=6 authored files, and <=800 total authored LOC. Remove separate schemas, runtime lock, harness canary, candidate contracts, and five-axis formal/reviewer replication unless one targeted claim demonstrably requires them.

The prompt itself must freeze the typed operation-graph equivalence rule, conditioning domain and norm, B64 quantity/normalization/denominator/arithmetic model, and deletion ownership. Until then XG-01, XG-07, XG-08, and the repository-deletion part of XG-10 are INCONCLUSIVE, not candidate-controlled PASS criteria.

Run deletion/constant/fixture mutants only on controlled post-seal copies. A hash, file-existence, or import failure does not count as a mutation kill. Each mutant must reach the named mechanism symbols and fail a scientific microcase assertion for the preregistered reason while the unmutated package passes.

Define global versus candidate-local stops: provenance or isolation error stops all; a candidate scientific non-PASS archives only that candidate and continues independent alternatives; tool absence is error/inconclusive; zero survivors is a successful no-go; multiple complete survivors are INCONCLUSIVE unless one prospectively frozen strict-dominance rule is satisfied.

Remove the mandatory candidate-specific five-PR list and exact future diff claims from the external deliverable. The current repository PR queue is empty. Only after one candidate passes intake and a separate owner design decision may the main writer produce an exact file/symbol/deletion plan; external deletion numbers remain estimates and cannot PASS a repository gate.

findings.statement: The draft self-authorizes generation, formal work, and executable manufactured-mechanism experiments even though the controlling state remains D-039 STOP/PRESERVE with only a read-only external design request. The intake-only final choice limits downstream authority but does not supply the missing upstream authority to execute this new external campaign.

External nonphysical execution is still execution and is distinct from read-only design advice.

The proposed lab is resource-bounded and external.

findings.statement: Several PASS rules are non-reconstructible or gameable. Non-isomorphism lacks frozen canonical graphs and an equivalence relation; conditioning and B64 lack a prompt-frozen domain, norm, normalization, denominator, and arithmetic model; an external estimate cannot prove an exact future net-minus-1000 repository diff; and mechanism deletion can be 'killed' by E0 hash/import failure without demonstrating scientific reachability. Package-wide first-non-PASS and exit semantics also fail to say whether one killed candidate suppresses independent alternatives.
assumptions_used: Candidate-selected preregistration inside its own returned bundle is not an independent prospective freeze.
A provenance failure is not evidence that mechanism mathematics reached a scientific assertion.
An unexecuted diff estimate is SPECIFIED, not VALIDATED.
counterevidence_refs: The draft attempts prospective thresholds, hostile mutants, fixed seeds, deterministic reductions, and a deletion counterfactual.
reproduction: Try to compute XG-01, XG-07, XG-08, or XG-10 solely from prompt-fixed definitions.
Delete mechanism.py and observe that a seal or import failure can satisfy the stated package-level kill without testing semantic reachability.

findings.statement: The mandatory candidate-specific five-PR list front-runs the only authorized positive outcome, which is intake review. It is also impossible to satisfy when the valid route verdict is NO_ADMISSIBLE_CANDIDATE. Requiring exact repository files, symbols, deletions, and an executable first PR before intake turns an external screen into a de facto implementation roadmap despite the draft's planning-only label.
